test_title: PYST 63: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight persons Reena, Kiran, Rahul, Deepak, Amit, Vikas, Preeti and Priya sit around a square table such that two persons sit in each of the sides. All the persons are sitting facing the centre of the table. Reena sits on the immediate right of Amit and they both sit on the same side. Preeti faces the one who is second to the left of Kiran. Preeti is sitting fourth to the right of Reena. Two persons sit between Vikas and Deepak (when counted from one side only) and Deepak is adjacent to Amit. Only one person sits between Preeti and Rahul (when counted from one side only). Who is sitting to the immediate left of Deepak?
solution:
Given: Eight persons - Reena, Kiran, Rahul, Deepak, Amit, Vikas, Preeti and Priya

1) Reena sits on the immediate right of Amit and they both sit on the same side.

2) Preeti is sitting fourth to the right of Reena. 

3) Preeti faces the one who is second to the left of Kiran.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed1ab95ab926dc804116603fbaf5e41a077c75d931dc78eea618cc0ec054910d.png] 

4) Two persons sit between Vikas and Deepak (when counted from one side only) and Deepak is adjacent to Amit.

5) Only one person sits between Preeti and Rahul (when counted from one side only).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b562248d5e689d260d8710fa9d73aff2071b4af937a070034a579cb949fbbd2.png] 

So, **Priya **is sitting to the immediate left of Deepak.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
